purpose: Part 1/2 of verified hard-tail 5-record item effect batch 024; together these files contain exactly 5 self-contained reviewed records.

items/golem-manual.name: Golem Manual
items/golem-manual.effectSummary: A golem manual grants +5 competence on checks to craft its designated golem body, supplies the required prerequisite spells by spell-trigger activation only for that construction, effectively grants Craft Construct, increases caster level for that golem as specified, and supplies the listed XP so the creator pays no XP cost; when construction finishes, the manual burns and its ashes animate the golem. Dragonbone manuals contain animate dead, cause fear, and geas/quest, grant +1 crafting caster level, and supply 4,400 XP; drakestone manuals contain animate objects, antimagic field, flesh to stone, and geas/quest, grant +3 caster levels, and supply 6,400 XP; ironwyrm manuals contain animate objects, antimagic field, geas/quest, incendiary cloud, and limited wish, grant +4 caster levels, and supply 8,000 XP.

items/quaals-cloak.name: Quaal's Cloak
items/quaals-cloak.effectSummary: The cloak continuously protects its wearer with feather fall. It begins with 50 charges; removing a feather consumes one charge and that feather functions as a Quaal's feather token.

items/cup-and-talisman-alakbar-461.name: Cup and Talisman of Al'Akbar
items/cup-and-talisman-alakbar-461.effectSummary: The Cup can turn water into a cure light wounds potion (1d8+1) seven times per day, which must be drunk directly from the cup, and can cast bless once per day at caster level 20. The Talisman grants remove disease at will and remove curse once per day. A nongood keeper of either artifact takes 1 permanent Constitution drain per day, cumulative if both are kept and recoverable only by wish or miracle; reaching Constitution 0 kills the keeper and makes them a deathless guardian bound to the artifact. Together, the artifacts allow resurrection of a nonevil creature three times per week after a 10-minute holy-water ritual without the normal material cost. Showing both together forces intelligent viewers to make Will DC 19 or attack the possessor out of greed; friendly creatures gain +4 on the save, and the effect ends when both artifacts leave sight.
